```{r include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(estimatr)
library(stargazer)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(gridExtra)
Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```


```{r}

setwd("C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/DATA/macro_data/fr")

my_files <- list.files()
# Obtenez la liste des fichiers .parquet
parquet_files <- my_files[grep("\\.parquet$", my_files)]

# Supprimez les fichiers .parquet de la liste des fichiers
my_files <- setdiff(my_files, parquet_files)

# Create a data frame with specified column names
dates <- data.frame(serie = character(),
                    start_date = as.Date(character()),
                    end_date = as.Date(character()),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

VAR_series <- NULL

plots <- list()

for (file in my_files){
  print(file)
  # Split the file name by underscore
  split_file <-  strsplit(file, split = "[_.]")
  # Extract the parts (strsplit returns a list)
  split_parts <- unlist(split_file)
  split_parts <- split_parts[3:length(split_parts)-1]
  name <- paste(split_parts, collapse = " ")
    # Concatenate the split parts with automatic line breaks
  title_text <- paste(strwrap(name, width = 30), collapse = "\n")
  
  excel_file <- read_excel(file, skip=10)
  
  # print(class(excel_file %>% head(1)))
  # print(colnames(excel_file %>% head(1)))
  
  start_date <- excel_file %>% head(1) %>% select(observation_date)
  end_date <- excel_file %>% tail(1) %>% select(observation_date)
  dates <<- rbind(dates, c(file, start_date[[1]], end_date[[1]]))
  
  if(is.null(VAR_series)){
    VAR_series <- excel_file
  }else{
    VAR_series <- merge( VAR_series ,excel_file, by= 'observation_date')
  }
  
  library(rlang)

  # Get the column name
  y_column <- colnames(excel_file)[2]

  #  Create the plot using aes and !!sym()
  my_plot <- ggplot(data = excel_file, aes(x = observation_date, y = !!sym(y_column))) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = title_text,
       x = 'Time',
       y = y_column)
  
  # my_plot <- ggplot(data = excel_file, aes_string(
  #   x = 'observation_date', y= colnames(excel_file)[2]))+
  #   geom_line()+
  #   theme_minimal()+
  #   labs(title= title_text,
  #        x= 'Time',
  #        y= colnames(excel_file)[2])
  # Add the plot to the list
  plots <- c(plots, list(my_plot))

}
# Specify the column names
colnames(dates) <- c('serie', 'start_date', 'end_date')
dates
```

I notice that some of the series about inflation have a seasonality. I want to get rid of it.

```{r}
library(xts)

setwd("C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_repo_gitlab/DATA/macro_data/fr")
print(list.files())
non_energ_inflation <- read_excel(
  "energy_index_ENRGY0FRM086NEST.xls", skip=10)

```


```{r}

non_energ_inflation$date <- as.Date(non_energ_inflation$observation_date)
# non_energ_inflation <- ts(non_energ_inflation)
print(class(non_energ_inflation$date))
# Create xts object with monthly frequency
xts_data <- zoo(non_energ_inflation$ENRGY0FRM086NEST, order.by = non_energ_inflation$date)

# Set the frequency explicitly
#frequency(xts_data) <- 12

# method 1 sommaire
# differentiate it
seasonality_adjusted <- diff(xts_data, lag = 12, na.rm = TRUE)
season_adj_data <- cbind(non_energ_inflation$date[-c(1:12)], as.data.frame(seasonality_adjusted))
colnames(season_adj_data)[1] <- c('date')

my_plot <- ggplot()+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title= 'Seasonal Adjustment', 
       x= 'Time',
       y= 'Energy Inflation')

# Plot original and seasonality-adjusted series
my_plot <- my_plot + geom_line(data=non_energ_inflation, 
    aes(x= date, y= ENRGY0FRM086NEST, color='Original-Data'))+
   geom_line(data= season_adj_data,
    aes(x= date, y= seasonality_adjusted, color='Seasonality-Adjusted'))

my_plot
```

Je transforme la serie a la main faute de savoir manier les packages de time series.

```{r}
# Load necessary packages
library(xts)
# serie_decomp<-decompose(serie,type=c("additive","mutliplicative"))
# test <- diff(xts_data,lag=12,difference=1)

seasonally_adjusted <- non_energ_inflation %>%
  filter(date >= as.POSIXct('1999-01-01')) %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date))

# Calcul de la moyenne mensuelle
monthly_means <- seasonally_adjusted %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(ENRGY0FRM086NEST))

# Jointure des moyennes mensuelles avec le DataFrame original
seasonally_adjusted <- seasonally_adjusted %>%
  left_join(monthly_means, by = "month") %>%
  mutate(deflated_ENRGY0FRM086NEST = ENRGY0FRM086NEST - mean_value,
 first_difference = ENRGY0FRM086NEST - lag(ENRGY0FRM086NEST))

my_plot <- ggplot()+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title= 'Seasonal Adjustment', 
       x= 'Time',
       y= 'Energy Inflation')

# Plot original and seasonality-adjusted series
my_plot <- my_plot + geom_line(data=seasonally_adjusted , 
    aes(x= date, y= ENRGY0FRM086NEST - mean(ENRGY0FRM086NEST), group='Original-Data'), color='darkblue')+ 
  geom_line(data=seasonally_adjusted,
    aes(x= date, y= deflated_ENRGY0FRM086NEST, group='Seasonality-Adjusted'), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'lightblue')
  # +geom_line(data=seasonally_adjusted,
  #   aes(x= date, y= first_difference, group='First Difference'), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'blue')

my_plot

```
